description: Returns how Intune Ready takes on work through partners: MSPs routing overflow, specialty or rescue Intune projects, and independent IT contractors subcontracting or referring a client. Covers the arrangements, what stays with the partner, and the client-ownership commitment. Carries no prices of its own — a partner engagement is priced from the tiers in get_offering. Use this for questions about subcontracting Intune work, white-label delivery, referring a client, or hiring an Intune specialist as an MSP or contractor.
